settings_source.v1: user first-round defaults; scheduler type/factor/patience/min_lr, optimizer, loss, AMP and microbatch inherited from baseline
settings_source.v2: v1 settings retained except 56:8 replay and fixed 5000 updates; user-prespecified development experiment

early_stop.v1: at >=2000 successful optimizer updates, 5 consecutive validations without improving constrained incumbent (includes f0)
early_stop.v2: disabled; complete 5000 successful optimizer updates unless an abnormal failure occurs
